Re-evaluation of Overfitting: The search path of ’method 2’ on its way to the global minima would be misconstrued as an overfitting, while ignoring all other paths which accomplish the same training goal. The plot insert is for a typical training path for the MNIST handwritten digits dataset from [3], which shows the training curves of the traditional SGD, the GDT for error-less training, and the GDT training whose training path ends at the joint global minimum sub-manifold for both the training and the test data.
Figure 3. No more test data: (a) Trained Voronoi cells without the test data. (b) The test data results in an error. Either (c) or (b) is a more accurate Voronoi cell formation than (a).
